name: elastic-badge-pop
title: Elastic Badge Pop
description: An interactive notification badge pill that squashes and springs into existence with vibrant rubberband momentum.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Symmetric
Density: Compact
Shape: Pill
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Accent Only

## Rules

- Toggle Pill Pop: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
